row.notes: Vtable cell 0x14561b780. Looks up model node 'halo' (djb2 0x7c97c1e9) and copies its rest transform back or writes a zero 3x4 transform per viewport using camera-settings byte +0x30; this+0x1b0c forces the update. The body also references the driver-model nodes (gloves_x, visor_x, helmet_, balaclava_x, harness_x, hans_device_x ...), so it handles more than the halo.
